storage.built_in: Dual SSD OS drives in RAID 1

features: Dedicated RAID controller card for video storage; OE-ZRAID5-MH converts the array from RAID 6 to RAID 5
Smart Motion channels: 64; server-side motion detection
Alarm inputs / relay outputs: optional upgrade (OE-ZIOMH)
Dual GbE: dedicated client and camera networks
Connects to OpenEye or ONVIF cameras
Maximum display resolution 4K (HDMI); D-Sub max 1080P; DisplayPort max 4096x2160
Country of origin: Assembled in the USA
notes: Drive bays differ: spec sheet and A&E chassis description state 16 bays; A&E capacity section states up to eight bays. Bay count left out.
